<script>
  (function () {
    // 移动端 canvas 被 CSS 隐藏，跳过 Rive 初始化
    if (window.innerWidth < 1280) return;

    const artboards = ["pdf_1", "pdf_2", "edraw_1", "edraw_2", "data"];
    const riveInstances = {};
    const RIV_SRC = "https://www.wondershare.com/home/20260403/ws_en_v01.riv";
    let rivBuffer = null; // 缓存 .riv 文件

    // 复用 jQuery 预加载的 .riv 缓存，避免重复下载
    function loadRivBuffer() {
      if (rivBuffer) return Promise.resolve(rivBuffer);

      // 优先使用 jQuery 中预加载的 window.rivBuffer（已缓存）
      if (typeof window.rivBuffer !== 'undefined') {
        rivBuffer = window.rivBuffer;
        return Promise.resolve(rivBuffer);
      }

      // 其次等待 jQuery 的 fetch Promise
      if (typeof window.rivBufferPromise !== 'undefined') {
        return window.rivBufferPromise.then(function(buf) {
          rivBuffer = buf;
          return buf;
        });
      }

      // 最后的备选：如果上面都没有，直接 fetch（不应该发生）
      console.warn('[.riv] 需要重新 fetch（预加载未正常工作）');
      return fetch(RIV_SRC)
        .then(function (res) { return res.arrayBuffer(); })
        .then(function (buf) { rivBuffer = buf; return buf; });
    }

    // 等待 rive 库加载完毕（改进：快速检查+超时保护）
    function waitForRive() {
      if (typeof rive !== "undefined") return Promise.resolve();
      return new Promise(function (resolve) {
        var checkCount = 0;
        var maxChecks = 200; // 最多检查200次 = 2秒
        var check = setInterval(function () {
          if (typeof rive !== "undefined") {
            clearInterval(check);
            resolve();
          } else if (checkCount++ > maxChecks) {
            clearInterval(check);
            console.warn('Rive library load timeout');
            resolve(); // 超时后强制继续，使用降级方案
          }
        }, 10); // 改为10ms，更快响应
      });
    }

    // jQuery 脚本已提前加载 .riv，无需在这里重复调用

    // 创建（或重建）单个 Rive 实例
    function createRiveInstance(name) {
      var canvas = document.getElementById("canvas-" + name);
      if (!canvas) return;
      if (!rivBuffer) {
        console.warn('Canvas ' + name + ': Rive buffer not ready, skipping');
        return;
      }

      // 如果已有旧实例，先销毁再重建，确保动画从头播放
      if (riveInstances[name]) {
        try {
          riveInstances[name].cleanup();
        } catch(e) {
          console.warn('Cleanup instance ' + name + ' failed:', e);
        }
        riveInstances[name] = null;
      }

      try {
        var instance = new rive.Rive({
          buffer: new Uint8Array(rivBuffer),
          canvas: canvas,
          autoplay: true,
          artboard: name,
          autoBind: true,
          stateMachines: "State Machine 1",
          onLoad: function () {
            instance.resizeDrawingSurfaceToCanvas();
          },
        });
        riveInstances[name] = instance;
      } catch(e) {
        console.error('Failed to create Rive instance for ' + name + ':', e);
      }
    }

    // ---- sticky section 滚动检测（替代 IntersectionObserver） ----
    // sticky 布局下 IntersectionObserver 无法正确判断被覆盖的 section，
    // 改用 scroll 位置 + offsetTop 计算当前活跃的 section
    var sectionMap = [
      { selector: '.part-document-editing', artboards: ['pdf_1', 'pdf_2'] },
      { selector: '.part-workflow-automation', artboards: ['edraw_1', 'edraw_2'] },
      { selector: '.part-data-management', artboards: ['data'] }
    ];
    var stickyWrapper = document.querySelector('.sticky-wrapper');
    var lastActiveSectionIdx = -1;
    var sectionFirstTriggered = {}; // 记录是否已经首次触发过（需要 600ms 延迟等 AOS）

    function getActiveSectionIndex() {
      if (!stickyWrapper) return -1;
      var wrapperRect = stickyWrapper.getBoundingClientRect();
      var vh = window.innerHeight;

      // wrapper 完全不在视口范围内
      if (wrapperRect.bottom < vh * 0.1 || wrapperRect.top > vh * 0.9) return -1;

      // 已滚入 wrapper 的距离
      var scrollIntoWrapper = -wrapperRect.top;
      var activeIdx = -1;

      for (var i = 0; i < sectionMap.length; i++) {
        var sectionEl = stickyWrapper.querySelector(sectionMap[i].selector);
        if (sectionEl && scrollIntoWrapper >= sectionEl.offsetTop - vh * 0.3) {
          activeIdx = i;
        }
      }
      return activeIdx;
    }

    function triggerSectionRive(idx) {
      var info = sectionMap[idx];
      if (!info) return;
      var isFirstTime = !sectionFirstTriggered[idx];
      sectionFirstTriggered[idx] = true;

      Promise.all([loadRivBuffer(), waitForRive()]).then(function () {
        // 优化：动态延迟判断
        // 1. 如果 Rive 库和 .riv 文件都已加载，首次进入时只延迟 100ms（让 AOS 稍微完成）
        // 2. 如果是再次进入，立即创建（资源已缓存）
        // 3. 如果首次加载失败，改用 50ms 兜底方案
        var delay;
        if (isFirstTime) {
          // 检查库和资源是否都已完成加载
          var rivLoaded = typeof rive !== 'undefined';
          var bufferReady = rivBuffer !== null;
          delay = (rivLoaded && bufferReady) ? 0 : 0;
        } else {
          delay = 0;
        }

        setTimeout(function () {
          info.artboards.forEach(function (name) {
            createRiveInstance(name);
          });
        }, delay);
      });
    }

    function checkStickySection() {
      var idx = getActiveSectionIndex();
      if (idx === lastActiveSectionIdx) return;
      lastActiveSectionIdx = idx;
      if (idx < 0) return;
      triggerSectionRive(idx);
    }

    // 用 rAF 节流的 scroll 监听
    var scrollRafId = null;
    window.addEventListener('scroll', function () {
      if (scrollRafId) return;
      scrollRafId = requestAnimationFrame(function () {
        scrollRafId = null;
        checkStickySection();
      });
    }, { passive: true });

    // 初始检查一次（处理页面直接刷新在中间位置的情况）
    checkStickySection();

    // 预初始化：在 DOMContentLoaded 后，确保 Rive wasm 立即被下载
    // 这样用户滚动时 wasm 已准备好，不需要等待
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        // 第一步：等待 Rive 库加载完毕
        var checkCount = 0;
        var initTimer = setInterval(function () {
          if (typeof rive !== 'undefined') {
            clearInterval(initTimer);

            // 第二步：Rive 库已加载，立即创建虚拟实例触发 wasm 下载
            // 这是关键步骤 - 不是创建真实动画，只是为了触发 wasm 初始化
            try {
              var tempCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
              tempCanvas.width = 1;
              tempCanvas.height = 1;
              new rive.Rive({
                canvas: tempCanvas,
                autoplay: false,
                onLoad: function() {
                  console.log('✅ Rive wasm 已预加载，canvas 动画可快速加载');
                }
              });
            } catch(e) {
              // 预热失败不影响正常使用
            }

            // 第三步：如果当前位置已经有 canvas，立即初始化（不需要等待滚动）
            setTimeout(function () {
              if (rivBuffer) {
                var currentIdx = getActiveSectionIndex();
                if (currentIdx >= 0) {
                  var info = sectionMap[currentIdx];
                  if (info && !sectionFirstTriggered[currentIdx]) {
                    info.artboards.forEach(function (name) {
                      createRiveInstance(name);
                    });
                    sectionFirstTriggered[currentIdx] = true;
                  }
                }
              }
            }, 50);
          } else if (checkCount++ > 200) {
            // 超时保护：即使 Rive 库加载失败也要继续
            clearInterval(initTimer);
            console.warn('Rive 库加载超时，使用降级方案');
          }
        }, 10);
      });
    } else {
      // 如果脚本在 DOMContentLoaded 后执行，直接检查
      if (typeof rive !== 'undefined') {
        try {
          var tempCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
          tempCanvas.width = 1;
          tempCanvas.height = 1;
          new rive.Rive({ canvas: tempCanvas, autoplay: false });
        } catch(e) {}
      }
    }

    // resize 节流
    var resizeTimer;
    window.addEventListener("resize", function () {
      clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
      resizeTimer = setTimeout(function () {
        artboards.forEach(function (name) {
          var inst = riveInstances[name];
          if (inst) inst.resizeDrawingSurfaceToCanvas();
        });
      }, 200);
    });
  })();

      if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
        var videoObserver = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {

              el.poster = el.getAttribute('data-poster');

<script>
  (function () {
    "use strict";

    const BP_DESKTOP = 1280;
    const ROOT_MARGIN = "300px 0px";
    const isDesktop = matchMedia(`(min-width:${BP_DESKTOP}px)`).matches;
    const $all = (sel, ctx = document) =>
      Array.from(ctx.querySelectorAll(sel));
    const VIDEO_SEL = "video.feature-video-src";

    /* Helpers */
    function ensureAutoplay(video) {
      video.muted = true;
      video.loop = true;
      video.playsInline = true;
      video.setAttribute("muted", "");
      video.setAttribute("playsinline", "");
    }

    function getWrap(video) {
      return video.closest(
        ".flexible-card-wrap, .feature-card-wrap, .card",
      );
    }

    function wireSources(video, preferMobile) {
      if (!video || video.dataset.wired) return;
      const url = video.getAttribute('data-src');
      if (!url) return;

      // 直接设置video的src属性
      video.src = url;
      video.dataset.wired = "true";

      // 必须调用load()使浏览器识别src的变化
      try {
        video.load();
      } catch {}
    }


    function stop(video) {
      try {
        video.pause();
        video.currentTime = 0;
      } catch {}
    }


    function playSafe(video) {
      ensureAutoplay(video);

      // Safari修复：直接播放，不调用load()
      // 浏览器会自动加载source的src
      try {
        const playPromise = video.play();
        if (playPromise !== undefined) {
          playPromise.catch((err) => {
            // 播放失败，可能是权限问题
            console.debug('Video play failed:', err);
          });
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.debug('Play error:', e);
      }
    }

    /* 重置视频到初始状态（显示 poster） */
    function resetVideoToPoster(video) {
      try {
        video.pause();
        video.currentTime = 0;
      } catch {}
    }

    /* Card item hover: 仅桌面端 - 悬停时播放，移出时暂停 */
    function initCardItemHover() {
      const cardItems = $all('.card-item');
      if (!cardItems.length) return;

      cardItems.forEach(cardItem => {
        const video = cardItem.querySelector(VIDEO_SEL);
        if (!video) return;

        const container = video.parentElement; // feature-card-video
        const posterImg = container ? container.querySelector('img.feature-card-poster') : null;

        cardItem.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
          if (posterImg) {
            posterImg.classList.add('hidden');
          }
          video.classList.add('playing');
          if (video.src) {
            try {
              video.play().catch(() => {});
            } catch {}
          }
        });

        cardItem.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
          try {
            video.pause();
            video.currentTime = 0;
          } catch {}
          video.classList.remove('playing');
          if (posterImg) {
            posterImg.classList.remove('hidden');
          }
        });
      });
    }

    /* Mobile card item: 移动端轮播 - 自动播放，隐藏poster */
    function initCardItemMobile() {
      const cardItems = $all('.card-item');
      if (!cardItems.length) return;

      cardItems.forEach(cardItem => {
        const video = cardItem.querySelector(VIDEO_SEL);
        if (!video) return;

        const container = video.parentElement; // feature-card-video
        const posterImg = container ? container.querySelector('img.feature-card-poster') : null;

        // 移动端：隐藏poster，video始终显示
        if (posterImg) {
          posterImg.classList.add('hidden');
        }
        video.classList.add('playing');
      });
    }

    /* Global IO: 所有feature-video-src的懒加载 */
    function initGlobalIO() {
      const videos = $all(VIDEO_SEL);
      if (!videos.length) return;

      const io = new IntersectionObserver(
        (entries) => {
          entries.forEach((entry) => {
            const v = entry.target;
            if (entry.isIntersecting) {
              // 进入视口时加载视频
              wireSources(v, !isDesktop);
              // 自动播放逻辑：
              // 1. 非card-item的视频：自动播放
              // 2. card-item的视频（移动端）：自动播放（桌面端由hover控制）
              const isCardItem = v.closest(".card-item");
              if (!isCardItem || !isDesktop) {
                playSafe(v);
              }
            }
          });
        },
        { root: null, rootMargin: ROOT_MARGIN, threshold: 0 },
      );

      videos.forEach((v) => io.observe(v));
    }

    /* Init */
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
      // 清空所有视频的src，由IO懒加载
      const allVideos = $all(VIDEO_SEL);
      allVideos.forEach((v) => {
        if (v.src) v.removeAttribute('src');
        v.querySelectorAll("source").forEach((s) => s.removeAttribute("src"));
      });

      // 初始化card-item的特殊处理
      if (isDesktop) {
        // 桌面端：hover控制播放
        initCardItemHover();
      } else {
        // 移动端：自动播放，隐藏poster（轮播模式）
        initCardItemMobile();
      }

      // 初始化IO懒加载（所有feature-video-src）
      initGlobalIO();
    });
  })();
</script>

<script>
  // 数字滚动动画（纯原生 JS，不依赖任何库）
  (function() {
    var animated = false;

    function easeOutExpo(t) {
      return t === 1 ? 1 : 1 - Math.pow(2, -10 * t);
    }

    function animateNumber(el) {
      var from = parseFloat(el.getAttribute('data-from')) || 0;
      var to = parseFloat(el.getAttribute('data-to'));
      var duration = parseFloat(el.getAttribute('data-speed')) || 800;
      var decimals = (String(to).split('.')[1] || '').length;
      var startTime = null;

      function step(timestamp) {
        if (!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
        var progress = Math.min((timestamp - startTime) / duration, 1);
        var value = from + (to - from) * easeOutExpo(progress);
        el.textContent = decimals > 0 ? value.toFixed(decimals) : Math.floor(value);
        if (progress < 1) {
          requestAnimationFrame(step);
        } else {
          el.textContent = decimals > 0 ? to.toFixed(decimals) : to;

      }

    if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
      var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
        for (var i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
          if (entries[i].isIntersecting && !animated) {
            observer.disconnect();

            setTimeout(runAllCounters, 800);
          }
        }
      }, { threshold: 0.15 });

      var section = document.querySelector('.part-trusted-around');
      if (section) observer.observe(section);
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('load', function() {
        setTimeout(runAllCounters, 2000);
      });
    }
  })();
